notice:   We vendor a subset of the upstream tree (RACE + FACT eval code,

Layout: vendor/ is FLAT — data/, utils/, prompt/, deepresearch_bench_race.py
sit directly under this directory, alongside COMMIT.txt + PATCHES.md.

To refresh from a fresh upstream clone:
  rm -rf data utils prompt *.py
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Ayanami0730/deep_research_bench.git /tmp/drb-upstream
  cd /tmp/drb-upstream && git rev-parse HEAD
  cp -r /tmp/drb-upstream/{data,utils,prompt,deepresearch_bench_race.py} \
        agent_bench/benchmarks/deepresearch_bench/eval/vendor/
  rm -rf /tmp/drb-upstream
Then re-apply the in-tree edits and pruning documented in PATCHES.md.

If this repo is ever redistributed publicly, restore upstream's LICENSE file
under vendor/ to comply with Apache-2.0 §4 (retention of license text).
